name: ASH/V$ASH 实时诊断方法论
description: V$ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY 每秒对所有活动会话采样一次，是 Oracle 实时性能诊断的核心数据源。方法论包括：先看 Top Events 定方向，再看 Top SQL 定目标，最后看 Session Details 定根因。采样数据的统计学解读是关键。

conditions.desc: 活动会话超过 CPU 核数 2 倍

root_causes.name: SQL 性能劣化
root_causes.desc: 某条 SQL 执行计划变差，占用大量 DB Time。ASH 中该 SQL 采样数显著增加。

root_causes.name: 锁争用
root_causes.desc: 大量会话等待 enq: TX - row lock contention 或 enq: TM - contention。

root_causes.name: I/O 瓶颈
root_causes.desc: db file sequential/scattered read 占比高。存储延迟增加。

root_causes.name: 内部争用
root_causes.desc: latch/mutex/buffer busy waits 等 Oracle 内部争用。

root_causes.name: 资源耗尽
root_causes.desc: CPU 100%、PGA/SGA 不足、进程数/会话数耗尽。

oltp.desc: 活动会话/CPU 比 > 5 需关注

olap.desc: 并行查询时活动会话高是正常的

step1_ash_top_events.desc: Top Wait Events（最近 5 分钟）
step1_ash_top_events.sql: SELECT NVL(event, 'ON CPU') event, wait_class, COUNT(*) samples, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) pct FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE GROUP BY event, wait_class ORDER BY samples DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step2_ash_top_sql.sql: SELECT sql_id, sql_plan_hash_value, COUNT(*) samples, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) sessions FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AND sql_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sql_id, sql_plan_hash_value ORDER BY samples DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step3_ash_blocking.sql: SELECT blocking_session, blocking_session_serial#, event, COUNT(*) blocked_samples FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AND blocking_session IS NOT NULL GROUP BY blocking_session, blocking_session_serial#, event ORDER BY blocked_samples DESC

step4_ash_timeline.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') ts, COUNT(*) active_sessions FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '10' MINUTE GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY ts

step5_ash_top_sessions.sql: SELECT session_id, session_serial#, user_id, program, COUNT(*) samples, COUNT(DISTINCT sql_id) distinct_sqls FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE GROUP BY session_id, session_serial#, user_id, program ORDER BY samples DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
